about: Your theme. Change only the "value" fields (or ask Claude: "use my colours #... and my font ..."). The "default" fields are the Peach Sorbet colours the recipes in styles.md are written in, so Claude can map each one to yours.
name: Peach Sorbet

white.role: Paper: cards, frames, pills and caption blocks

butter.role: Accent: the one key word per frame, highlights, ticks, canvases

blush.role: Soft: chips, tags, avatars, pinboards, subtitle pills

cocoa.role: Ink: all text, borders, cursors, arrows, shadows (shadow is this colour at 25-30% opacity)

burgundy.role: Deep: the #scrapbook room and the #glowup After card; gradient runs light, mid, dark

cream.role: Warm paper: kinetic and flashcard backgrounds, monitor bezel

accent.role: Typewriter labels (Course 5 only), system font, nothing to install
